title: JetStream restore format detection can buffer excessive data
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

JetStream accepts stream backups from authorized users and detects the backup format before restoring a stream.

### Problem Description

The format-detection stage could retain incoming compressed data without a finite buffer limit while waiting for recognizable output. A user allowed to restore streams could cause excessive memory use and disrupt the server process. Account stream-storage limits did not bound this temporary detection buffer.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.15.1. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.
